landing.interviewTitle: Practice interviews tailored to your exact target role.
landing.interviewSubtitle: Answer questions built from your resume and experience level, then receive immediate scoring and model answers.
landing.interviewBullet1: Questions generated from your resume and target job description
landing.interviewBullet2: AI scoring from 1 to 10 with clear strengths and improvements
landing.interviewBullet3: Model answers to help you structure better responses
landing.interviewBullet4: Coverage for behavioral, technical, and situational prompts
landing.interviewQuestion: Tell me about a time you resolved a technical disagreement within your team.
landing.interviewUserAnswer: Two engineers disagreed on REST vs GraphQL for our API. I ran a benchmark on core endpoints to compare latency. Data showed GraphQL cut payload size by 40%, so we agreed on a hybrid rollout.
landing.interviewStrength1: Clear situation with data-backed conflict resolution
landing.interviewStrength2: Focused on team consensus rather than taking sides
landing.interviewImprove1: Add the specific business impact after rollout
landing.interviewImprove2: Mention how you documented the API standard
